salmanshh_uidirector.name: UIDirector
salmanshh_uidirector.description: Layer-based UI manager with focus stack, popup system, animations, modal control, and collision management. Track any layer as a named screen, popup, or tooltip - then open, close, and navigate between them with simple actions.

uiContainerLayer.name: UI Container Layer
uiContainerLayer.desc: Name of the group layer in your layout that contains all managed UI sublayers. Example: if your group layer is called "UI", enter "UI" here. Leave blank to search the whole layout.

defaultAnimType.name: Default Animation
defaultAnimType.desc: The default transition animation played when showing or hiding a layer. Can be overridden per-layer with the Set animation action.

defaultAnimDuration.name: Default Duration (ms)
defaultAnimDuration.desc: How long the default transition animation takes, in milliseconds. Example: 200 = a quick 0.2 second fade.

defaultAnimEasing.name: Default Easing
defaultAnimEasing.desc: The easing curve applied to the default animation. EaseOut feels snappy and responsive; EaseInOut feels smooth.

dimLayer.name: Dim Layer
dimLayer.desc: Optional. The name of a layer inside your UI container to use as a dim/scrim overlay. UIDirector will show this layer at the set opacity whenever a modal screen or popup is active, and hide it when none are. Leave blank to disable.

dimOpacity.name: Dim Opacity
dimOpacity.desc: The opacity of the dim layer when it is active (0 = invisible, 1 = fully opaque). Default is 0.5 (50% semi-transparent).

persistAcrossLayouts.name: Persist Across Layouts
persistAcrossLayouts.desc: If enabled, UIDirector remembers tracked layers and their states when the layout changes. Layer references are re-resolved on the new layout.

debugMode.name: Debug Mode
debugMode.desc: If enabled, UIDirector logs all operations to the browser console (F12 -> Console). Useful during development - turn off before release.

SetAnimation.display-text: Set {0} animation {1}, {2} ms, {3}, mirror on back {4}
SetAnimation.description: Overrides the open/close animation for a single layer: type, duration, easing, and whether back-navigation mirrors the direction. Configure once; it plays automatically on every show and hide.

type.name: Animation type
type.desc: The transition animation to play when this layer opens or closes.

durationMs.name: Duration (ms)
durationMs.desc: How long the animation takes, in milliseconds.

easing.name: Easing
easing.desc: The easing curve applied to the animation.

mirrorOnBack.name: Mirror on back
mirrorOnBack.desc: When true, the closing animation plays in the opposite direction on back-navigation (slide/scale reverse). Ignored for fade and none.

SetData.description: Stores a custom key/value on a tracked layer. Read it back with the LayerData expression. Use to attach context like a selected item ID to a screen.

layerName.name: Layer name
layerName.desc: The tracked layer to store data on.

value.name: Value
value.desc: The value to store under the key.

SetInputEnabled.description: Toggles a layer's interactivity (isInteractive) without changing its visuals. Use to temporarily block buttons during an animation or loading.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.desc: True = layer receives pointer/touch input. False = layer ignores input.

SetLayerState.description: Changes a layer directly to visible, hidden, or disabled, playing the layer's animation. Use to show or hide a HUD element or grey out a panel without touching the focus stack.

state.name: State
state.desc: Visible (shown + interactive), Hidden (not shown), or Disabled (shown but input blocked).

SetModal.description: Sets whether a screen blocks input on all other screens while it is active. Use to make fullscreen menus modal.

layerName.name: Layer name
layerName.desc: The tracked normal-role layer to modify.

modal.name: Blocks others
modal.desc: True = make all other screens non-interactive while this one is active (restored on close). False = leave them unchanged.

SetTimescale.description: Controls playback speed tied to a layer. Objects timescale changes the speed of every object on the layer now (1 = normal, 0 = frozen, -1 = no change). Game-while-open is stored and auto-applied to the whole game when this layer opens, then restored on close (-1 = off). Pass 1 / 1 to clear. Tip: objects 1 + game-while-open 0 keeps the menu animated while the game freezes behind it.

instanceTimescale.name: Objects timescale
instanceTimescale.desc: Per-object timescale applied to all instances on the layer now. 1 = normal, 0 = frozen, 2 = double speed. Use -1 to leave object timescales unchanged.

runtimeTimescale.name: Game-while-open timescale
runtimeTimescale.desc: Global runtime timescale to apply automatically when this layer opens, and restore on close. Use -1 to clear or skip the runtime override.

SyncCollisions.description: Enables or disables automatic collision syncing on a layer: when on, object collisions are disabled while the layer is hidden/disabled and restored when it shows. Use to stop invisible UI from blocking game clicks.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.desc: True = automatically manage collisionsEnabled on instances. False = leave collision states unchanged.

GoBack.display-text: Go back to the previous screen
GoBack.description: Returns to the previous screen, like a Back button. Pops the focus stack with animation; does nothing if the stack is empty. Use for the Escape key or back arrows.

GoToFirstScreen.description: Clears the navigation history and returns to the root (first) screen. Use for a 'Main Menu' shortcut from deep inside nested menus.

GoToScreen.description: Navigates to a screen. Push remembers the current screen so the player can go back; Replace swaps without remembering; Return to unwinds the history back to this screen.

layerName.name: Layer name
layerName.desc: The name of the screen layer to go to.

mode.name: Mode
mode.desc: Push = remember the current screen (default navigation). Replace = swap the current screen without adding to history. Return to = pop back to this screen if it is in history.

GoToScreenWithData.description: Stores a key/value on the target screen and then navigates to it (Push). Read the value back with the LayerData expression. Use to pass context like a selected item into the screen.

layerName.name: Layer name
layerName.desc: The name of the screen to go to.

key.name: Key
key.desc: The data key to store on the screen.

value.name: Value
value.desc: The value to store under the key.

Popup.description: Shows or hides a popup overlay above the current screen. Show timed auto-dismisses after the given milliseconds; Hide all closes every open popup. Duration is only used by Show timed.

mode.name: Mode
mode.desc: Show = open the popup. Hide = close it. Show timed = open then auto-dismiss after Duration. Hide all = close every open popup.

layerName.name: Layer name
layerName.desc: The popup layer to show or hide. Ignored for Hide all.

durationMs.name: Duration (ms)
durationMs.desc: Only for Show timed: how long the popup stays open before auto-dismissing, in milliseconds.

Tooltip.description: Shows or hides a tooltip. Only one tooltip is visible at a time — showing a new one hides the previous. Hide active hides whichever tooltip is currently showing.

mode.name: Mode
mode.desc: Show = display this tooltip (hides any other). Hide = hide this tooltip. Hide active = hide whichever tooltip is currently showing.

layerName.name: Layer name
layerName.desc: The tooltip layer to show or hide. Ignored for Hide active.

SetupLayer.description: Registers a layer with UIDirector as a screen, popup, or tooltip with sensible defaults. Call once at the start for each UI layer you want to manage.

layerName.name: Layer name
layerName.desc: The name of the sublayer inside your UI container group layer.

role.name: Role
role.desc: Screen = full-page navigation (pushed/popped on the focus stack). Popup = overlay above the current screen. Tooltip = single transient hint, off the stacks.

SetupLayerAdvanced.description: Registers a layer with full control over modal blocking and collision syncing. Use when the defaults from Setup layer are not what you want.

layerName.name: Layer name
layerName.desc: The name of the sublayer inside your UI container group layer.

role.name: Role
role.desc: Screen = full-page navigation. Popup = overlay above the current screen. Tooltip = single transient hint, off the stacks.

modal.name: Modal (blocks others)
modal.desc: True = while this layer is the active screen, all other screens become non-interactive (restored on close).

syncCollisions.name: Sync collisions
syncCollisions.desc: True = automatically disable object collisions on this layer while it is hidden or disabled, and restore them when it shows.

Untrack.description: Stops UIDirector from managing a layer. Leave the name blank to untrack everything and clear all stacks.

layerName.name: Layer name
layerName.desc: The tracked layer to remove. Pass an empty string ("") to untrack all layers and reset every stack.

FinishAnimation.description: Instantly completes a layer's running transition (and any per-object animations). Leave the name blank to finish every running animation at once. Use to skip transitions on a fast-forward or skip button.

layerName.name: Layer name
layerName.desc: The tracked layer whose animation to finish. Pass an empty string ("") to finish all running animations.

LayerAcceptsInput.description: True when the layer's isInteractive is on (it accepts clicks and touches). Use to guard button logic so it only runs when the layer is interactive.

LayerBlocksOthers.description: True when this layer is modal (blocks input on all other screens while active). Use to decide whether a dimmed overlay should appear.

LayerIsAnimating.description: True while a layer is playing its show/hide transition animation. Use to disable buttons until the screen finishes sliding in.

LayerIsInState.description: True when a layer's current state matches the chosen one. Use to check a layer before acting on it.

LayerIsReady.description: True when a layer is visible or focused AND not mid-animation. Use to only allow button clicks once a screen has fully appeared.

LayerIsVisible.description: True when the layer and all its parents are visible (includes disabled layers). Use to check if a HUD or panel is currently on screen.

CanGoBack.description: True when there is a previous screen to return to. Use to show or hide a Back button. UIForge checks this before driving back-navigation.

NoScreensOpen.description: True when the focus stack is empty. Use to detect when the player has backed out of all menus.

ScreenIsActive.description: True when this screen is on top of the focus stack. Use to show controls that only appear on a specific screen.

ScreenIsInHistory.description: True when this screen appears anywhere in the focus stack. Use to avoid navigating to a screen that is already open.

layerName.name: Layer name
layerName.desc: The screen to search for in the navigation history.

OnScreenHidden.description: Triggers when a screen leaves the focus stack (e.g. after Go back). Use PreviousScreen inside. Good for resuming music or cleaning up after leaving a screen.

OnScreenShown.description: Triggers when a screen becomes the active screen. Use FocusedLayer / PreviousScreen inside. Good for playing a sound or starting an intro effect.

AnyPopupVisible.description: True when one or more popups are open. Use to dim the background or block input while a dialog is showing.

TooltipIsVisible.description: True when a tooltip is currently showing. Use to suppress other hover effects while a tooltip is up.

OnPopupClosed.description: Triggers when a popup hides. Use to check the player's choice after a confirmation dialog.

OnPopupOpened.description: Triggers when a popup becomes visible. Use TopPopup inside. Good for playing a sound or dimming the background.

LayerIsTracked.description: True if UIDirector is managing this layer. Use as a safety check before calling other actions on it.

OnAnyLayerStateChanged.description: Triggers whenever any layer changes state. Use with LastChangedLayer and LastChangedState for global UI tracking. Companion addons poll these to follow the active screen.

OnLayerClosed.description: Triggers after a layer finishes its closing animation. A safe point to clean up or stop timers once the layer is fully gone.

OnLayerClosing.description: Triggers when a layer starts its closing animation. Good for fading out music or starting a parallel exit effect.

OnLayerOpened.description: Triggers after a layer finishes its opening animation. A safe point to enable controls or start effects once the layer is fully visible.

OnLayerOpening.description: Triggers when a layer starts its opening animation. Use LayerAnimProgress / LayerAnimDirection inside. Good for starting music or parallel intro effects.

OnLayerStateChanged.description: Triggers after a specific layer finishes changing state. Use LayerState / PreviousLayerState inside. Good for logic that depends on the final state.

layerName.name: Layer name
layerName.desc: The layer to watch for state changes.

LayerData.description: Returns a stored custom value from a layer by key, or empty. Use to read data set with Set data or Go to screen with data.

LayerRole.description: Returns a layer's role: 'normal', 'popup', 'tooltip', or empty if untracked. Use for debug displays or role-specific logic.

LayerState.description: Returns a layer's current state: 'visible', 'hidden', 'disabled', 'focused', or empty if untracked. Use for debug displays or conditional logic.

PreviousLayerState.description: Returns the state a layer was in before its last change, or empty. Use to restore a layer after a temporary change.

CurrentScreen.description: Returns the name of the active screen, or empty if none. Use for screen-specific logic or debug displays.

FocusedLayer.description: Returns the name of the active (focused) screen, or empty if none. Alias of CurrentScreen. Polled alongside LastChangedLayer by companion addons.

FocusStackDepth.description: How many screens are currently in the focus stack. 0 = none, 1 = one screen, 2+ = deeper. Use for breadcrumbs or depth indicators.

PreviousScreen.description: Returns the name of the screen directly below the active one in the stack, or empty. Use for breadcrumbs or 'Back to X' button labels.

ActiveTooltip.description: Returns the name of the visible tooltip, or empty if none. Use for custom logic based on which tooltip is showing.

TopPopup.description: Returns the name of the topmost open popup, or empty if none. Use to check which dialog the player is looking at.

CountTrackedLayers.description: Returns the total number of layers currently tracked by UIDirector. Use with GetTrackedLayerByIndex in a Repeat loop to iterate all tracked layers.

GetTrackedLayerByIndex.description: Returns the name of a tracked layer at the given zero-based index. Use with CountTrackedLayers in a Repeat loop to iterate all tracked layers.

index.name: Index
index.desc: Zero-based index of the tracked layer (0 = first tracked, CountTrackedLayers - 1 = last).

LastChangedLayer.description: Returns the name of the layer whose state most recently changed. Use inside state-changed triggers to know which layer fired the event. Polled by companion addons to follow the active screen.

LastChangedState.description: Returns the new state of the most recently changed layer. Use inside state-changed triggers to react differently to 'hidden' vs 'visible'. Polled by companion addons.

LayerAnimDirection.description: Returns a layer's animation direction: 'opening', 'closing', or empty. Use to play different sounds based on whether a screen is coming in or going out.

LayerAnimProgress.description: Returns a layer's animation progress from 0 to 1 (0 if idle). Use to sync custom effects like fading music with a screen's transition.
